epic.title: Finance & Fee Management Module
epic.body: Handles all fee configuration, invoicing, collection, tracking, reconciliation, and reporting across multi-organization and multi-branch institutes with accuracy, auditability, and scalability.

features.title: Fee Structure Configuration
features.body: Administrators can define class-wise fee structures including granular fee heads (Tuition, Transport, Lab, etc.) and installment plans for an academic year.

stories.title: Manage Fee Structures (Frontend)
stories.body: As an admin, I want to create, list, update, and delete fee structures for different classes so that I can set clear financial expectations for each grade.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Admin can view existing fee structures filtered by class name.
Create: Form to add a new structure with class mapping, academic year, and multiple fee breakdown items.
Update: Ability to edit existing structure details including installment dates and amounts.
Delete: Option to remove a fee structure with a confirmation prompt.
Validation: Ensure total amount is calculated automatically based on fee head breakdown.

stories.title: Fee Breakdown & Installment Persistence (Backend)
stories.body: API to store and manage the details of fee heads and installment schedules associated with a class.
acceptanceCriteria: POST/PUT endpoints to save fee structure objects containing arrays of breakdown items and installments.
GET endpoint to retrieve structures by classId and academicYear.
DELETE endpoint to remove structures and ensure data integrity with student records.

features.title: Student Fee & Payment Management
features.body: Comprehensive tracking of individual student payments, balances, and collection management including receipt generation.

stories.title: Student Payment & Ledger Management (Admin)
stories.body: As an admin, I want to record new payments, view payment history, and update payment status for individual students.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Search and filter student fee records by name, roll number, class, and payment status (Paid, Partial, Overdue).
Create: Add payment modal to record transactions including amount, mode (Cash, UPI, Card), and reference numbers.
View: Detail view for student payment history showing receipt numbers and collection dates.
Auto-Update: System must automatically recalculate student balance and update status (e.g., to 'Paid') upon recording a payment.

stories.title: Fee Dashboard & Analytics (Admin)
stories.body: High-level summary of financial health including total collectibles, collected fees, and overdue amounts.
acceptanceCriteria: Display cards for Total Collectible, Collected, Pending, and Overdue amounts.
Collapsible stats section to optimize screen space for list views.
Export/Download: Option to download payment reports or receipts (UI placeholder exists).

stories.title: Payment Transaction Processing (Backend)
stories.body: API for processing payments and maintaining the audit trail of all financial transactions.
acceptanceCriteria: POST endpoint to record a transaction and generate a unique receipt number (REC...).
Logic to handle partial payments and update the 'nextDue' object for the student.
GET endpoints to fetch student-specific ledgers and global collection stats.
